per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The parts search should complete in under 15 seconds to avoid disrupting the user's workflow.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The facility lookup should complete in under 8 seconds to ensure smooth customer interactions.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Audit report generation should complete in under 10 seconds to avoid disrupting the user's workflow.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle up to 1,500 simultaneous users without significant performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be able to handle up to 1500 simultaneous users. The system shall perform with 1500 users as a time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle spotty connectivity gracefully in the field, ensuring that users can continue working without significant disruptions.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide warnings before session timeouts and implement draft autosave to prevent loss of unsaved work.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should implement role-based access control, with admins having full access and other roles having restricted access based on their responsibilities.
